parsed.rationale: All four duplicate `SequentialMockSession.data` methods reside in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`, a test file in the `Artwork` package. Although the pipeline did not set `is_test=true` on these records, the file path (`Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`) and the enclosing type names (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`) unambiguously place them inside per-test-class nested mock helpers. Each `SequentialMockSession` is a locally scoped mock whose `data` method is duplicated intentionally to keep each test class self-contained and independently evolvable. Consolidating them would couple otherwise independent test suites and reduce test isolation.
